agenda_text:
City Council
AGENDA
la puente City Council
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
JULY 13, 2010
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER:
Mayor Argudo called the meeting to order at 7:05 p.m.
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
Mayor Pro Tem Holloway led the Pledge of Allegiance.
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION TO THE CITY OF LA PUENTE FOR ITS SUPPORT OF THE 2010 CENSUS
PRESENTATION ON IMAGINATION PLAYGROUND IN A BOX
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION
F.
CLOSED SESSION
F-1
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.9(a) TO CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL--EXISTING LITIGATION KZC Construction, Inc. v. City of La Puente, et al.; Case Number: KC057240
F-2
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.9(b) CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - ANTICIPATED LITIGATION (TEN CASES)
RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING
REPORT OUT OF CLOSED SESSION
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS - None.
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS - None.
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS - None.
D.
CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1277 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2009-10 AND 2010-2011
CC.D-1 Resoultion Warrant Register #1277
D-2
AWARD OF CONTRACT TO FABRICATE AND INSTALL THREE (3) BUS SHELTER ENCLOSURES
Action Taken: The City Council: 1) awarded the bid for the bus shelter replacement project to LNI Custom Manufacturing; and 2) approved Resolution No. 10-4886 adjusting the FY 2010-11 budget by allocating an additional $20,000.00 to account number 48-5503-0000-69.
CC.D-2 Bus Shelter Replacement Report
CC.D-2 Bus Shelter Replacement Att. A
CC.D-2 Bus Shelter Replacement Att. C
D-3
AWARD A CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT FOR COMPUTER ROOM COOLING SERVICES
Action Taken: The City Council: 1) awarded the contract to Spec Construction Inc., in the amount of $15,995; and 2) authorized the City Manager to approve change orders up to 10% of the bid amount.
CC.D-3 Computer Room Report
CC.D-3 Computer Room Attach A
D-4
BID AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE HACIENDA BOULEVARD SEWER TRENCH REHABILITATION
Action Taken: The City Council: 1) awarded the construction contract to Miramontes Construction Co., in the amount of $460,960.00 for the Hacienda Boulevard Sewer Trench Rehabilitation; and 2) authorized the City Manager to execute any necessary change orders in an amount not to exceed fifteen (15%) percent of the original contract amount.
CC.D-4 Hacienda Sewer Trench Rehabilitation Report
CC.D-4 Hacienda Sewer Trench Rehabilitation Attach A
CC.D-4 Hacienda Sewer Trench Rehabilitation Attach B
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF SCHOLARSHIP AWARDS FOR FY 2010-11
Action Taken: The City Council awarded 18 scholarships for the 2010-2011 academic year and scheduled a presentation of awards at the City Council Meeting on July 27, 2010.
CC.D-5 Scholarship Awards FY 2010-11 Report
CC.D-5 Scholarship Awards List of Applicants Attach A
D-6
THE REASSIGNMENT OF VARIOUS ORDINANCE NUMBERS FOR ADMINISTRATIVE RECORD CLARIFICATION
Action Taken: The City Council: 1) approved the reassigned Urgency Ordinance No. 10-901 for Urgency Ordinance No. 10-899 – An Urgency Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente amending Chapter 5.58 of the La Puente Municipal Code by revising and amending various code sections relating to medical marijuana cooperatives and collectives, adopted at the June 8, 2010, meeting; and 2) approved the reassigned Ordinance No. 10-902 for Ordinance No. 10-900 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente amending Chapter 5.58 of the La Puente Municipal Code by revising and amending various code sections relating to medical marijuana cooperatives and collectives, adopted at June 22, 2010 meeting; and 3) approved the reassigned Ordinance No. 10-903 for the proposed Ordinance No. 10-901 – An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente adding Chapter 10.100 to Title 10 (Zoning) of the La Puente Municipal Code to prohibit the establishment and the operation of medical marijuana cooperatives and collectives in the City (Municipal Code Amendment No. 131), continued to the City Council meeting on July 27, 2010.
CC.D-6 Ordinance Numbering Clarification _Reassignment_
E.
NEW BUSINESS - None.
COUNCIL AB1234 REPORTS - None.
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF - None.
ADJOURNMENT
There being no other business to come before the City Council, Mayor Argudo adjourned the meeting at 9:48 p.m. in memory of Joe Sotros.
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this
___________________________________
Pat Jacquez-Nares, CMC, City Clerk
